verses.text: Ha Jehová tz'ak'an sakil k'inal t'ayin, in Kolumal paxi. ¿Machto wal b'aj syal in xiwi? Ha tzin kolani, yuj chi' malaj b'aj tzin xiwi.
Ha heb' chuk smol sb'a t'a in patik yik tzin satanel heb' yalani, palta a heb' ayoch ajk'olal chi' t'ayin, ol lajwokel heb'.
Wach'chom junok b'ulan soldado tz'och hoyan t'a in patik wichanh, wal yel, manh ol in xiwlaj. Wach'chom sk'e waan heb' yak' owal wet'ok, hanheja' wak'anoch Dios yipok in k'ool.
Junnhej wal tas tzin k'an t'a Jehová, haton jun tik tzin nib'ej: To tzin ek' t'a stemplo Dios yakb'an pitzan in yik swil sniwanil yelk'och Dios chi', swak'anpaxem in b'a t'ay.
Ayik ol jawok yaelal t'a wib'anh, a ol in k'ub'anelok. Ha t'a skajnub', hata' ol in sk'ub'ejeli. Ol in yik'k'e t'a yib'anh junok k'een yik tzin kolchajkaneli.
Ichaton wal chi' ol aj in skolankanel t'a heb' ajk'ool oyanoch t'a in patik wichanh. T'a skal aw yet' tzalajk'olal ol wak' in silab' t'a Jehová t'a yol stemplo. Ol wal wach' lolonel t'a b'ital t'ay.
Mamin, a t'ayach tzin awaji, cha ab' t'ayin. Ok'ok wal a k'ool t'ayin, tak'wanh t'ayin.
Mamin Jehová, a in pensar ix halan t'ayin to tzin nitzkot in b'a t'a a tz'ey. Yuj chi' swak' wip in nitzanoch in b'a t'a a tz'ey chi'.
Manh a k'ub'ejel a b'a t'ayin. Manh in a chek meltzaj yet' yowal a k'ool. Ha achtaxon tzin a kolo'. Ach in Diosal in Kolumal ach, manh in aktejkan in ch'okoj.
Mamin Jehová, wach'chom tzin yaktejkan heb' in mam in nun, palta a ach ol in a tanhwej.
Mamin, ch'ox a b'e t'ayin, ik' in b'at t'a yol b'e tojol, yuj heb' ajk'ool snib'an in yak'an telwok.
Manh in ak'kanoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin. Sk'e waan heb' t'a in patik, syesan in mulok heb'. Snib'ej heb' tzin yak' chamok.
Mamin Jehová, swak'och t'a in k'ool to ol a ch'ox a wach'k'olal t'ayin yakb'an pitzan into, tato maay, toxom ix pax wip naik.
Ex wetchonhab', ak'ekoch Jehová yipok he k'ool. Tek'tek' tzeyutej he b'a, manh eyak' chab'ax he k'ool. Wal yel, ak'eknhejoch Jehová yipok he k'ool.
